item.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
item.passage: The ability to select a set of surroundings suitable for foraging, shelter from predators, and the availability of mates is one of the most important determinants of biological success ― measured as survival to reproductive age and the production of offspring. (A) For example, the blackthroated green warbler, a small songbird that nests in spruce forests of eastern North America, establishes territories preferentially among the red spruce trees early in the summer months, even though these trees offer less food than the neighboring white spruce trees. (B) Later, though, when nests are built and hungry baby birds need nourishment, it is the red spruce forest that offers the easier pickings. Somehow, the warbler has been guided to settle in locations that will suit its future parenting needs better than its present ones. (C) Many studies have shown that not only do animals have a remarkable ability to seek out the best available locations for the necessities of life, but that they are able to anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.

units.text: The ability to select a set of surroundings suitable for foraging, shelter from predators, and the availability of mates is one of the most important determinants of biological success ― measured as survival to reproductive age and the production of offspring.

(A) For example, the blackthroated green warbler, a small songbird that nests in spruce forests of eastern North America, establishes territories preferentially among the red spruce trees early in the summer months, even though these trees offer less food than the neighboring white spruce trees.
(B) Later, though, when nests are built and hungry baby birds need nourishment, it is the red spruce forest that offers the easier pickings.
Somehow, the warbler has been guided to settle in locations that will suit its future parenting needs better than its present ones.

(C) Many studies have shown that not only do animals have a remarkable ability to seek out the best available locations for the necessities of life, but that they are able to anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.

answer_locus.quote: Later, though, when nests are built and hungry baby birds need nourishment, it is the red spruce forest that offers the easier pickings.
answer_locus.reasoning: [u5]가 주어진 글 [u1]의 장소 선택 능력을 'anticipate ... future needs' 로 넓혀 (C)가 첫머리다. [u2]의 'For example' 이 이 주장을 휘파람새 사례로 받는다. [u3]의 'Later, though' 는 [u2]의 'early in the summer months' 와 'less food' 를 뒤집어 받으므로 (A) 뒤에 (B).

choice_analysis.why_tempting: 주어진 글이 장소 선택 능력을 말하므로 곧바로 휘파람새 사례 (A)를 붙인다.
choice_analysis.how_to_reject: [u2]의 'For example' 이 받을 주장은 '미래 필요의 예측'인데, 주어진 글 [u1]에는 예측 이야기가 없고 [u5]에만 있다. 사례가 주장보다 앞설 수 없다.

choice_analysis.why_tempting: (B)의 'red spruce forest' 가 장소 선택을 말해 주어진 글 뒤에 바로 붙을 듯하다.
choice_analysis.how_to_reject: [u3]의 'Later, though' 는 앞선 시점을 전제하는데 그 시점 'early in the summer months' 는 [u2]에 있다. (B)를 (A) 앞에 두면 'Later' 가 기준 시점을 잃는다.

choice_analysis.why_tempting: (B)를 주어진 글 뒤, (C)의 일반 주장을 그다음에 두면 사례-정리처럼 보인다.
choice_analysis.how_to_reject: [u3]의 'the red spruce forest' 는 정관사로 이미 소개된 숲을 가리키는데, red spruce 가 처음 소개되는 곳은 [u2]다.

choice_analysis.why_correct: [u2]의 'For example' 이 [u5]의 'anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs' 를 받고, [u3]의 'Later, though' 가 [u2]의 'early in the summer months ... less food' 와 시간·평가를 동시에 대비시킨다. (C)-(A)-(B) 에서만 두 이음매가 닫힌다.

confirmed_at.note: [u4]는 (B) 안의 결론이라 순서 확정력은 [u2]·[u3] 이음매에 있다

choice_analysis.why_tempting: (C)의 일반 주장 뒤 'future needs' 를 'Later' 가 받는 듯해 (B)를 바로 붙인다.
choice_analysis.how_to_reject: [u3]의 'though' 는 앞 내용과 반대되는 사실을 잇는데, [u5]는 반대될 것이 없는 일반 주장이다. 뒤집힐 대상('less food')은 [u2]에만 있다.
